title: Belief-State Management Meets Rubric Rewards for Agentic Forecasting
title_zh: 结合信念状态管理与评分量表奖励的智能体预测
abstract_en: Current large language model (LLM) agents still struggle to forecast real-world events. This stems from two primary limitations: i) standard ReAct harness accumulates reasoning and evidence within one growing context, and ii) outcome-based rewards in forecasting lead to a slow and noisy signal that cannot distinguish sound reasoning from lucky guesses. To address these, we introduce a forecasting training framework including harness design and post-training. For the harness side, we propose Proactive Belief-State Management (PBM), equipping agents with a fold tool to compress lengthy context into compact belief states and reset the context for subsequent exploration. For the training side, we develop SEIPH, a five-dimensional, outcome-blind rubric, providing process-quality rewards. Using the rubric-based reward, we post-train a 35B model with PPO and GRPO, yielding DeepForecaster-PPO and DeepForecaster-GRPO. Theoretically, we prove that idealized fold-based stopping converges and calibrated local rewards reduce segment-level gradient variance. Empirically, DeepForecaster-PPO (35B) achieves the best Brier score on both ForecastBench and Polymarket-Sim, outperforming frontier agents based on DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T), Kimi-K2.6 (1T), and GPT-5.5. DeepForecaster-GRPO ranks second on both FutureX metrics. Ablations reveal that PBM also improves the untrained base model without any training. Calibration analysis shows that DeepForecaster-PPO makes more accurate high-confidence predictions than Qwen3.6 and GPT-5.5. Trajectory analysis further shows that forecasts generally improve from the first to the final belief state as agents gather evidence and revise their judgments.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在预测现实事件时面临两项困难：标准 ReAct 框架将推理与证据不断累积在同一上下文中；基于事件结果的奖励反馈缓慢、噪声大，且难以区分可靠推理与侥幸猜中。论文提出一套结合智能体框架设计与后训练的预测方法：主动信念状态管理（Proactive Belief-State Management，PBM）借助 fold 工具将长上下文压缩为简洁的信念状态，并重置上下文以继续探索；五维评分量表 SEIPH 不依赖事件结果，直接为推理过程的质量提供奖励。作者以该奖励对一个 35B 模型分别进行 PPO 和 GRPO 后训练，得到 DeepForecaster-PPO 与 DeepForecaster-GRPO。理论上，论文证明了理想化条件下基于 fold 的停止机制会收敛，且经校准的局部奖励可降低片段级梯度方差。实验中，DeepForecaster-PPO 在 ForecastBench 和 Polymarket-Sim 上均取得最低 Brier 分数，优于基于 DeepSeek-V4-Pro（1.6T）、Kimi-K2.6（1T）和 GPT-5.5 的智能体；DeepForecaster-GRPO 在 FutureX 的两项指标上均排名第二。消融实验表明，PBM 无需额外训练即可改善基础模型的预测。进一步分析显示，DeepForecaster-PPO 的高置信度预测比 Qwen3.6 和 GPT-5.5 更准确；随着智能体收集证据并修正判断，预测通常从初始信念状态到最终信念状态逐步改善。
key_points_zh: PBM 用 fold 工具将已积累的证据和推理压缩为信念状态，再重置上下文继续探索；消融实验显示，无需额外训练也能改善基础模型的预测。
SEIPH 从五个维度评价推理过程，无需等待事件结果；理论分析表明，经校准的局部奖励可降低片段级梯度方差。
35B 的 DeepForecaster-PPO 在 ForecastBench 和 Polymarket-Sim 上取得最低 Brier 分数；DeepForecaster-GRPO 在 FutureX 的两项指标上均排名第二。
DeepForecaster-PPO 的高置信度预测比 Qwen3.6 和 GPT-5.5 更准确；轨迹分析显示，随着证据积累和判断修正，预测通常有所改善。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: PBM 让文本智能体主动折叠上下文，将搜索轨迹划分为可独立评分的片段；SEIPH 用不依赖事件结果的过程反馈更新搜索、推理和折叠策略。消融量化了同权重下的框架收益及强化学习后的表现变化，但 ReAct 与 PBM 的强化学习起点不同，不能完全分离分段奖励与 SFT 的作用。PPO 相对 SFT 降低了 Brier 分数，但略降二分类准确率并增加了生成开销；未验证跨任务迁移，也未展示改进机制自身的改进。
